output.title: Four-Bedroom Semi-Detached House with Parking and South-Facing Garden
output.description:
This well-maintained semi-detached house, constructed in the 1990s, offers 195 m² of living space designed to accommodate a range of residential needs. The brick facade and small front garden contribute to the established and tidy residential ambiance of the property. A private driveway provides convenient parking for residents.

The living room features an open-plan layout that transitions smoothly into the dining area, with tile flooring and a functional fireplace. Double doors open directly onto the south-facing rear garden, enhancing natural light and accessibility.

The kitchen is finished in a traditional style, equipped with warm wood cabinetry and a tile splashback. It includes a freestanding cooking range and a breakfast nook, creating a practical and inviting space.

The rear garden features a south-facing lawn and a private patio, offering an outdoor area suited to various activities or leisure. Additional storage needs are met with a separate cellar on the premises.

Overall, this property presents a comfortably sized residential option within its setting, combining indoor and outdoor living with practical features including parking and storage.

highlights.text: Four bedrooms providing ample sleeping space
Brick facade characteristic of 1990s Luxembourg houses
Open-plan living and dining area with fireplace
Kitchen with breakfast nook and freestanding range
